metadata.name: p1-reference-scale-six-tab-mobile-sequence
metadata.description: Bounded repeatability diagnostic on the fixed reference-scale-v1 dataset at 390x844: record three separate Today document-mount samples, then three warm Today→Plan→Goals→Focus→Review→Settings→Today cycles (three actual tab-click transitions per selected route). Preserve useful-data readiness, all-time calibration over 10,000 linked readings, actual-click Event Timing (16 ms threshold), profile-build React subtree commit measures, resource timing, overlapping Long Tasks, service-worker observations and same-origin assertions. The registered setup case runs first under the same routed lease and is excluded from measurement. Diagnostic only; no product latency budget gate.
